entities.mob.npc.Aaron.NAME: Aaron
entities.mob.npc.Aaron.DIALOG_TEXT: Adventurer, come... hear my tale and decide your fate. Long ago there was a fisherman named Stuarth who lived in Redwater Village. One day, when Stuarth was on a fishing trip here in Morhollow Marsh, he hooked the biggest fish he had ever seen...

entities.mob.npc.Barda.NAME: Barda
entities.mob.npc.Barda.DIALOG_TEXT: Scouting the cliffs is an important job, you know. I am responsible for reporting all irregularities to Greenwell in the South.

entities.mob.npc.Briwor.NAME: Briwor
entities.mob.npc.Briwor.DIALOG_TEXT: This is the focal point of the Pinnacle of Elements. Once the required evils have been vanquished, a portal here shall take you to the true enemy.

entities.mob.npc.Bryce.NAME: Bryce
entities.mob.npc.Bryce.DIALOG_TEXT: We never should have been here to begin with...

entities.mob.npc.CaptainAznar.NAME: Captain Aznar
entities.mob.npc.CaptainAznar.DIALOG_TEXT: We must hold Elkmire Keep at all costs

entities.mob.npc.CommanderOrim.NAME: Commander Orim
entities.mob.npc.CommanderOrim.DIALOG_TEXT: What do you need? I am busy kid.

entities.mob.npc.Dain.NAME: Dain
entities.mob.npc.Dain.DIALOG_TEXT: There is no way this town is getting finished while those undead monsters are lurking just South of here!

entities.mob.npc.Favian.NAME: Favian
entities.mob.npc.Favian.DIALOG_TEXT: Ryia and I protect this passage to ensure the safety of Redwater

entities.mob.npc.Gorvenal.NAME: Gorvenal
entities.mob.npc.Gorvenal.DIALOG_TEXT: I ordered a drink from Rosa a while ago but have not gotten it yet. Understandable though... It is pretty busy in here.

entities.mob.npc.Harold.NAME: Harold
entities.mob.npc.Harold.DIALOG_TEXT: If you travel to the Southeast, you will find the small village of Redwater. Folks there might be able to assist you on your journey.

entities.mob.npc.HellcloakMage.NAME: Hellcloak Mage
entities.mob.npc.HellcloakMage.DIALOG_TEXT: Sharp minds live longer up here

entities.mob.npc.HellcloakWarrior.NAME: Hellcloak Warrior
entities.mob.npc.HellcloakWarrior.DIALOG_TEXT: My sword thirsts for the blood of my enemy

entities.mob.npc.Jade.NAME: Jade
entities.mob.npc.Jade.DIALOG_TEXT: Welcome to Redwater! You can store your items here. I will keep them safe.

entities.mob.npc.Ryia.NAME: Ryia
entities.mob.npc.Ryia.DIALOG_TEXT: Decided to venture into the Catacombs eh?

entities.mob.npc.Sadon.NAME: Sadon
entities.mob.npc.Sadon.DIALOG_TEXT: The seal has been broken and Atax is vulnerable! Strike now, adventurer!

entities.mob.npc.Sybbyl.NAME: Sybbyl
entities.mob.npc.Sybbyl.DIALOG_TEXT: Hello there. Care to use my storage facility?
